stories.quote: Hightide has made it much easier to organise reservations, track payments and share availability. We are now receiving many bookings directly through our Online Store, which saves time and gives customers more confidence. Before Hightide, I managed bookings through WhatsApp and Instagram and tracked everything in an Excel calendar, which meant a lot of back and forth over pricing, payments and availability.
stories.name: Pete Webb

stories.quote: Direct bookings have been a game changer for us. Hightide makes bookings much easier to manage and brings everything together at a reasonable price, without hidden fees. Before Hightide, I managed everything through Google Calendar, which made the booking flow, blocking unavailable dates and offering direct bookings difficult. I am very happy with it.
stories.name: Alessandro Rista

stories.quote: Once beds, lessons and weekly bundles lived on our own store, guests started booking direct — and we stopped retyping the same reservation details into three places. We used to rely on OTAs for most surf-week packages, which meant less margin and more manual coordination across beds and lessons.
stories.name: Marta Silva

stories.quote: Now balances, dietary notes and room moves sit on the booking — and the team opens one day planner instead of five tabs. Retreat season used to mean chasing deposits in email and updating a shared spreadsheet every morning.
stories.name: Elena Vasquez

stories.quote: Hightide let us sell the full stay online, then run arrivals, payments and partner settlements from the same booking record. Lodge beds, guided hikes and partner agent bookings all shared the same calendar chaos before we moved everything into one workspace.
stories.name: James Okonkwo
